en_title: Heated Rivalry Star Connor Storrie in Talks to Play Villain in MCU's Ghost Rider Movie
cn_title: 漫威《恶灵骑士》反派选角洽谈中
subtitle: 从冰场走向反派
opus_summary: 《巅峰对决》演员正洽谈出演漫威《恶灵骑士》反派，具体角色尚未明确，将与瑞恩·高斯林饰演的强尼·布雷泽对阵。影片预计明年开拍，目标于2028年7月上映。

paragraphs.en: Heated Rivalry actor Connor Storrie is in talks to play the villain in Ryan Gosling's Ghost Rider movie.
paragraphs.cn: 《巅峰对决》演员Connor Storrie正洽谈出演瑞恩·高斯林主演的《恶灵骑士》电影，饰演片中的反派。

paragraphs.en: According to The Hollywood Reporter , the actor will go toe-to-toe with Gosling's Johnny Blaze. There were some questions over whether or not Gosling would play a different Ghost Rider, but Blaze always made the most sense, and that appears to be the case, per THR's reporting. As of right now, we're not sure which villain Storrie would portray. However, it would be a big leap forward for the actor, who exploded onto the scene earlier this year in the hockey romance series Heated Rivalry.
paragraphs.cn: 据好莱坞报道者报道，Storrie将与高斯林饰演的强尼·布雷泽正面对抗。此前有人猜测，高斯林是否会饰演另一位恶灵骑士，但布雷泽一直都是最合理的人选，而好莱坞报道者的报道也表明，情况似乎确实如此。目前，我们还不清楚Storrie会饰演哪位反派。不过，对今年早些时候凭借冰球题材爱情剧《巅峰对决》一举成名的他来说，这将是演艺事业的一大跨越。

paragraphs.en: The actor had also previously starred in Joker: Folie à Deux, as the inmate who fatally stabs Arthur Fleck and is heavily implied to be the "real Joker." Although he had only a couple of minutes of screen time, the role was significant in terms of its impact. Now, it looks like he'll be given a chance to play a real villain in one of the biggest franchises in cinematic history.
paragraphs.cn: Storrie此前还出演过《小丑2：双重妄想》，饰演刺死亚瑟·弗莱克的囚犯，影片强烈暗示这名囚犯才是「真正的小丑」。虽然他只出场了几分钟，但这个角色带来的影响相当大。如今，他似乎有机会在电影史上规模最大的系列之一中，饰演一位真正的反派。

paragraphs.en: The MCU's Ghost Rider film was confirmed at San Diego Comic-Con this summer, and production has been ramping up rather quickly. The film is expected to begin shooting next year and will target a July 2028 release date . Shawn Levy will direct the film after developing a good relationship with Marvel on Deadpool and Wolverine and Ryan Gosling on his upcoming film Star Wars: Starfighter .
paragraphs.cn: 漫威电影宇宙的《恶灵骑士》电影于今年夏天在圣迭戈国际动漫展上正式公布，制作工作推进得相当快。影片预计明年开拍，目标于2028年7月上映。肖恩·利维将执导本片。他此前通过《死侍与金刚狼》与漫威建立了良好的合作关系，也在执导即将上映的《星球大战：星际战机》时，与瑞恩·高斯林建立了良好的合作关系。

paragraphs.en: THR also notes that Dune Part 3‘s Linus Sandgren has already been tapped to be the director of photography on the new Ghost Rider movie, and the project will shoot on film. Although this is now a rarity, it's in vogue once again thanks to directors like Christopher Nolan and Ryan Coogler championing the format while successfully getting audiences on board.
paragraphs.cn: 好莱坞报道者还指出，《沙丘3》的Linus Sandgren已获选担任新版《恶灵骑士》的摄影指导，影片将使用胶片拍摄。如今，胶片拍摄虽然已不多见，但在克里斯托弗·诺兰和瑞恩·库格勒等导演的支持下，这种拍摄方式再度流行起来，他们也成功赢得了观众的认可。

paragraphs.en: Not much else is known about the new Ghost Rider film, but it will be one of the first films post- Avengers: Secret Wars , which should usher in a new era of the MCU. Only time will tell where Johnny Blaze's story will take us, but it sounds like it'll be an exciting prospect.
paragraphs.cn: 关于新版《恶灵骑士》，目前已知的其他信息不多，但它将是《复仇者联盟6：秘密战争》之后首批上映的电影之一，后者预计将为漫威电影宇宙开启一个新时代。强尼·布雷泽的故事会带我们走向何方，只有时间能给出答案，不过听起来值得期待。
